_readme: Hand-curated activities with a FIXED weekly timetable that their site does not publish as a calendar (a games night, a conversation group, a course, a climbing session). Each entry is expanded into one dated event per meeting; the crawler then groups them as one series. To add one, append an object to `activities`. Required: id (kebab-case, stable, never change it once published: it keys saved/hidden state), title, city, url (the OFFICIAL page where you verified the timetable), summary (one honest line, say when the timetable is by request), weekdays (mon..sun), time (HH:MM, local), from and until (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive: the run; for a season use its first and last day). Optional: venue, durationMin, everyWeeks (default 1), skip (days with no meeting), tags, category (primary category id), verified:false (timetable not confirmed: shown as 'Date da confermare'). Never guess a timetable. Not for things on request with no fixed dates (those are not events).
